product: The sgit command line, versions 0.16.0 and 0.17.0
gap: pull silently discards uncommitted edits to tracked files.
abp_impact: An agent that writes to a vault and pulls before committing loses the write with no error. A record kept in a vault is only as durable as the agent's commit discipline.
risk_to_accept: Lost edits. Workaround: commit before pull. Accepted by nobody; this one is a defect in our own estate and is reported.
evidence: Reproduced by the contributor in a throwaway vault; report and script on request. This site's own session on 22 September cloned a vault with 0.16.0 and did not exercise pull.
request: pull refuses, stashes, or merges when tracked files have uncommitted edits; a regression test.
reported_by: the RiskMandate.ai agent team, in a brief pack to this site dated 4 October 2026, pasted by the editor of record; self reported, not verified by this site
